shortDescription: Module for setup of Gslb Avi RESTful Object

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: async_interval
options.description: Frequency with which messages are propagated to vs mgr. Value of 0 disables async behavior and rpc are sent inline. Allowed values are 0-5. Field introduced in 18.2.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.

options.name: avi_api_patch_op
options.description: Patch operation to use when using avi_api_update_method as patch.

options.name: avi_api_update_method
options.description: Default method for object update is HTTP PUT. Setting to patch will override that behavior to use HTTP PATCH.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_disable_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Disable Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: clear_on_max_retries
options.description: Max retries after which the remote site is treated as a fresh start. In fresh start all the configs are downloaded. Allowed values are 1-1024. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 20.

options.name: client_ip_addr_group
options.description: Group to specify if the client ip addresses are public or private. Field introduced in 17.1.2.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: User defined description for the object.

options.name: dns_configs
options.description: Sub domain configuration for the gslb. Gslb service's fqdn must be a match one of these subdomains.

options.name: is_federated
options.description: This field indicates that this object is replicated across gslb federation. Field introduced in 17.1.3. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as True.

options.name: leader_cluster_uuid
options.description: Mark this site as leader of gslb configuration. This site is the one among the avi sites.

options.name: maintenance_mode
options.description: This field disables the configuration operations on the leader for all federated objects. Cud operations on gslb, gslbservice, gslbgeodbprofile and other federated objects will be rejected. The rest-api disabling helps in upgrade scenarios where we don't want configuration sync operations to the gslb member when the member is being upgraded. This configuration programmatically blocks the leader from accepting new gslb configuration when member sites are undergoing upgrade. Field introduced in 17

options.name: name
options.description: Name for the gslb object.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: send_interval
options.description: Frequency with which group members communicate. Allowed values are 1-3600. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 15.

options.name: send_interval_prior_to_maintenance_mode
options.displayName: Send Interval Prior To Maintenance Mode
options.description: The user can specify a send-interval while entering maintenance mode. The validity of this 'maintenance send-interval' is only during maintenance mode. When the user leaves maintenance mode, the original send-interval is reinstated. This internal variable is used to store the original send-interval. Field introduced in 18.2.3.

options.name: sites
options.description: Select avi site member belonging to this gslb.

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_ref
options.description: It is a reference to an object of type tenant.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: third_party_sites
options.description: Third party site member belonging to this gslb. Field introduced in 17.1.1.

options.name: url
options.description: Avi controller URL of the object.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: uuid
options.description: Uuid of the gslb object.

options.name: view_id
options.description: The view-id is used in change-leader mode to differentiate partitioned groups while they have the same gslb namespace. Each partitioned group will be able to operate independently by using the view-id. Default value when not specified in API or module is interpreted by Avi Controller as 0.
